title: review.json
description: The structured half of a review bundle, written to outbox/<YYYY-MM-DD-slug>.review/. The prose half is review.md, which is what a model reads; the two carry the same comments in the same order with the same numbering.

documentId.description: The id from the document's meta.json, verbatim, so the sender can match on it.

closingInstruction.description: The 'Anything to add?' field. Always present; empty when the user left it blank.

inkPages.description: Only pages carrying ink. A 50-page document with marks on two pages has two entries.

id.description: Short and stable within one bundle: C1, C2, … A model quoting 'C2' back is more use than one quoting a UUID.

index.description: 1-based, matching the '### n — page m' heading in review.md.

text.description: The comment, post-corrected against the document term list.

anchor.description: What the comment is attached to. Quoted text is the primary key; the rect is the fallback when text matching fails. Never a line number.

quoted.description: The selected text, exactly as it appeared.

prefix.description: Up to 32 characters immediately before the quote.

suffix.description: Up to 32 characters immediately after the quote.

normalisedRect.description: [x, y, width, height] as fractions of the page, origin top-left with y increasing downwards (UIKit view space, not PDF user space). Values outside 0..1 are legal: ink can be drawn off the margin.

sourceRange.description: [start, end) half-open UTF-8 byte offsets into source.md. Present only when the document was rendered from markdown and a sourcemap.json was generated.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based; the filename is one-based, so pageIndex 0 is ink/page-01.png.

image.description: Bundle-relative path to the cropped PNG.

recognisedText.description: PKStrokeRecognizer output for the page. Omitted when recognition found nothing or the user turned the toggle off.

included.description: The four Include toggles from the review sheet. The first three default on.
